comments.body: add reasoning for version limit as a comment in this file

@prateekdesai04 @Innixma investigated an alternative that avoids pinning setuptools entirely. Since mmdet 3.3.0 supports mmengine>=0.7.1, <1.0.0, we can upgrade the full stack:

```bash
python3 -m pip install "mmengine==0.11.0rc2"
python3 -m pip install "mmcv==2.1.0" --no-build-isolation --timeout 60
python3 -m pip install "mmdet==3.3.0"
```
mmengine 0.11.0rc2 replaces pkg_resources with importlib natively ([open-mmlab/mmengine#1676](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmengine/pull/1676)), so no setuptools<82 pin needed at all.
Worth testing — if it passes CI, the only follow-up would be updating the AutoGluon docs which currently reference mmdet==3.2.0.
